result.reason: The revision minimally improves the duration to the 90-day software fallback and removes the obsolete outside expiration date, while preserving the existing remedy structure. However, it does not reach the full playbook position: it adds no professional-and-workmanlike services warranty, no compliance-with-laws warranty, and retains a malicious-code warranty limited to code that was “willfully introduced” and only during the Warranty Period. The margin comment is also inaccurate because the original warranty ran from the Effective Date with a December 31, 1999 cutoff; it did not expire on the acceptance date.
